description: Find or create a Workroom DM thread between a merchant user and an AI colleague. Use this when an inbound event deserves owner attention but no threadId was provided. This only prepares an internal Workroom channel.

agentId.description: AI colleague ID for the Workroom DM

title.description: Optional title if a new thread is created

userId.description: Merchant user ID to notify. Defaults to the current MCP user when omitted.

name: find_or_create_workroom_thread

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
